grammarOverview.title: Grammar Overview (Cumulative)
grammarOverview.summary: Rafael's current precision work is intentionally narrow: tense selection, complete and natural sentence framing, and accurate phrasing during spontaneous speech. Older observed patterns remain in cumulative memory rather than competing with the current three.
focusPoints: Present perfect vs simple past: distinguish unfinished or present-relevant situations from completed past actions; keep habits separate from one-off events.
Natural reflective framing & sentence completion: connect past experience to present meaning with complete sentences, accurate collocations and smoother transitions.
Past tense consistency: continue consolidating completed past forms while avoiding unnecessary continuous framing in narratives.
Natural phrasing & comparatives: avoid literal translations and choose more idiomatic English structures.
Passive voice for reporting: use passive forms appropriately in formal and news-style communication.
Say vs Tell: maintain the correct listener/message structure.
Third conditional: use had + past participle and would have + past participle for unreal past outcomes.

teacherFeedback.title: July learning memory
teacherFeedback.body: July evidence shows strong communicative stamina across personal, political and reflective topics, with increasing awareness of tense selection and natural framing.

teacherFeedback.title: Current Teacher Feedback
teacherFeedback.body: Rafael's B2 communication is strong and sustained, especially in analytical and reflective contexts. The current path toward C1 is not about accumulating more topics; it is about more precise tense selection, more natural sentence framing and more deliberate lexical choice during spontaneous speech. The authoritative attendance record now stands at 11 of 15 attended, so restoring the weekly rhythm matters for the recycling work already identified. No CEFR change is being claimed from the current evidence.

classReports.title: Italy trip storytelling and BBC current events
classReports.summary: Rafael retold his Italy trip chronologically and used a BBC international-news report for listening, retelling and verification work. The lesson also reviewed the simple past for completed events and experiences.
classReports.teacherInsight: The lesson showed strong communicative instinct and effective real-world language use even when grammar was not perfect.

classReports.title: Professional experience, geopolitics and advanced fluency
classReports.summary: The lesson combined storytelling, Rafael's tax-auditor background, pandemic work changes, geopolitical analysis and passive reporting language for complex real-world discussion.
classReports.teacherInsight: Rafael demonstrated strong analytical ability and willingness to communicate even when searching for vocabulary.

classReports.title: Lifestyle, technology and political institutions
classReports.summary: Real-life conversation moved from health and lifestyle to technology, education and political institutions in Rio de Janeiro, with sentence clarity and comparative forms identified as precision targets.
classReports.teacherInsight: Rafael's fluency supports complex real-life discussion; grammatical precision is the next development step.

classReports.title: Dream storytelling and AI in business and society
classReports.summary: Spontaneous storytelling and AI/business discussion developed listening, interpretation and summarizing, while grammar work focused on more reliable verb use and say-versus-tell structure.
classReports.teacherInsight: Rafael can process and explain complex ideas effectively; accuracy and consistency in core sentence patterns remain the priority.

classReports.title: Structured storytelling and emotional expression
classReports.summary: A structured retelling of the Italy trip developed emotional vocabulary, narrative organization and the distinction between past simple and past continuous.
classReports.teacherInsight: With structure, Rafael's speech became clearer and more organized, and his self-correction in past forms showed growing control.

classReports.title: Homes, cooking and complex political explanation
classReports.summary: The lesson integrated home, cooking and gardening vocabulary with explanation of a complex political situation, while consolidating the past simple and step-by-step explanation.
classReports.teacherInsight: Rafael explained a highly complex political situation with very few gaps and showed stronger awareness of past-simple self-correction.

classReports.title: Political polarization, civic participation and third conditional
classReports.summary: The lesson focused on political polarization in Brazil, civic participation, voting systems and institutions, using the third conditional to discuss hypothetical past political outcomes.
classReports.teacherInsight: Analytical and opinion-based discussion remained a major strength; advanced hypothetical grammar required more precision.

classReports.title: Education, career and public administration
classReports.summary: Rafael discussed education, family responsibilities, career choices and professional development while expanding tax-law and public-administration vocabulary and consolidating past-simple narration.
classReports.teacherInsight: Rafael strengthened personal-event narration and professional vocabulary while continuing to consolidate past-simple awareness.

classReports.title: Puppy, home decoration, antique shopping and consistency
classReports.summary: A long spontaneous conversation about a new puppy, home decoration and antique shopping expanded personalized vocabulary and highlighted present-perfect versus simple-past distinctions and study consistency.
classReports.teacherInsight: Rafael showed excellent conversational stamina; the main need was sharper grammar and vocabulary control in highly spontaneous moments.

classReports.title: Responsibility, resilience and lifelong learning
classReports.summary: Reflective speaking connected political context, family responsibility, life transitions, self-reliance and lifelong learning, with attention to natural framing between past experience and present meaning.
classReports.teacherInsight: Rafael expressed values, memory, responsibility and emotional tension with sincerity and depth; this is one of his strongest communicative contexts.
